meta.title: Barutyan UJ — Power of Kindness
meta.description: Charitable foundation in Armenia helping war survivors, people with disabilities, vulnerable families, orphanages and elderly homes.
meta.keywords: charity, Armenia, donation, Barutyan UJ, Power of Kindness

hero.headline: Kindness that reaches those who need it most
hero.subtitle: We support people affected by war, people with disabilities, vulnerable families, orphanages and elderly homes across Armenia.

mission.title: Who we help
mission.lead: Barutyan UJ exists to turn compassion into concrete help for people who need support today.

war.title: War survivors
war.text: Support for people and families affected by conflict — shelter, care and a path back to stability.

disability.title: People with disabilities
disability.text: Practical assistance that improves daily life, dignity and access to essential services.

families.title: Vulnerable families
families.text: Help for socially unprotected and low-income households facing hardship.

homes.title: Orphanages & elderly homes
homes.text: Ongoing support for children without parental care and for residents of elderly homes.

reports.title: We already help
reports.lead: Transparent work, real stories. Reports and case updates will appear here as our programmes grow.

one.title: Community support
one.text: First aid packages and food assistance for families in need.

two.title: Care facilities
two.text: Material support for orphanages and elderly homes.

three.title: Inclusion
three.text: Targeted help for people with physical disabilities.

reports.note: Detailed financial and activity reports will be published regularly.

donate.title: Become a benefactor
donate.lead: Bank transfers are the simplest way to support our work. Copy the account number for your currency.
donate.hint: Please include “donation — Barutyan UJ” in the transfer comment when possible.

blog.title: Stories & updates
blog.lead: Follow our programmes, reports and community stories.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.text: Barutyan UJ (“we”) respects your privacy. This page explains what data we collect on our website and why.

form.title: Contact form
form.text: When you send a message we process your name, email and message content to respond. If you opt in to news, we store your email to send updates about our work and blog posts. You can unsubscribe by emailing us.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: We may use Google Analytics and Yandex Metrika to understand how the site is used. These tools may set cookies. You can block cookies in your browser settings.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For privacy requests write to mr.alex.abraham2002@mail.ru or call +374 41 277 725.
